edits.find: The detail that invites over-reading: last bowel movement 5 days ago, with loose stool. Constipation with loose stool is overflow diarrhea, liquid stool passing around a hard impaction, and is near-pathognomonic.
edits.with: The last bowel movement was 5 days ago, and the stool is loose stool now. Loose stool after days of constipation is overflow diarrhea: liquid stool passing around a hard impaction, and near-pathognomonic.

edits.find: Part I Cholestasis & the LFT Patterns owns the adult conjugated-versus-unconjugated framework; this brief owns its neonatal form.
